part.text:
I've stopped the robot in front of the red end wall, and it's now resting.

It followed the corridor through its several corners, which took a lot of trial and error. Several times it hit walls it had to back out of and try a different opening. The last stretch ended with the red wall directly ahead, and the robot couldn't walk any closer, so it's a little short of touching it. The final camera image shows the red wall and the robot's feet at the bottom edge.

Battery is at 99%.
